ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the diagram, the perimeter of rhombus $ABCD$ is 40, and the diagonal $BD=12$. What is the area of the rhombus $ABCD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that the perimeter of rhombus $ABCD$ is 40,\\
thus, the length of side $BC=10$,\\
since $BD=12$,\\
then $OB=\frac{1}{2}BD=6$,\\
thus $OC=\sqrt{BC^{2}-OB^{2}}=\sqrt{10^{2}-6^{2}}=8$,\\
therefore $AC=2OC=16$,\\
hence the area $S_{\text{rhombus}ABCD}=\frac{1}{2}AC\cdot BD=\frac{1}{2}\times 12\times 16=\boxed{96}$.
